Taktful - audio analysis library (BPM, key, note presence)
https://github.com/am0k161/Taktful
Commit: b6b4e0d ("note presence") + reconstructed include/taktful/notes.h
        (missing from the upstream commit; rebuilt from src/notes.cpp and
        cli/analyze_wav.cpp usage, verified against the upstream test suite)
License: MIT (see LICENSE)

Vendored files:
  include/taktful/*.h   public API headers (13 files)
  src/*.cpp, src/simd.h library implementation (11 translation units)
  data/ref_profiles.h   key-profile tables included by src/key.cpp (-Idata)

Not vendored: cli/, tests/, docs/, third_party/ (kiss_fft placeholder only),
.github/, create_test_wav.cpp, prebuilt notes_probe binary.

Build notes:
  - Compile with -I<dir>/include -I<dir>/data (key.cpp includes ref_profiles.h).
  - C++14 or later; NEON paths auto-enable when __ARM_NEON is defined
    (aarch64 builds get them by default); TAKTFUL_ENABLE_NEON=0 forces scalar.
  - Do not define TAKTFUL_USE_KISSFFT: third_party/kiss_fft is a placeholder
    with no code; the built-in radix-2 FFT is used instead.
